name: OpenHands
description: OpenHands Agent Canvas — a fully self-hosted control plane for running fleets of coding agents across your software development lifecycle. It is the self-hosted alternative to Warp Factories: the control plane (conversations, runs, transcripts, automations, workspaces) runs on this box, and the agents run against the local LLM (vLLM) and the local project (Phone-Projects) with the local Android SDK. No cloud, no subscription, MIT-licensed. The UI is served at the root of the subdomain and is gated behind the RunTipi login.
short_desc: Self-hosted control plane for a fleet of coding agents (OpenHands Agent Canvas)
author: Morteza Rastgoo
